desc: Define a function `check(T)` that calculates the total cost of buying all units whose marginal cost is $\le T$ for all products.
For each $P_i$, calculate max units $k_i$ such that $(2k_i-1)P_i \le T$. (Note: Formula correction needed here).
Binary search for the largest $T$ such that `check(T) <= M`. Range for $T$: $[1, 2 \cdot 10^{18}]$.
Calculate total units $ans = \sum k_i$ for the optimal $T$.
Find the product with the smallest marginal cost for the next unit (which corresponds to $k_i+1$ for some $i$).
If such a unit exists, increment $ans$ and subtract cost from $rem$. Repeat until no single unit can be afforded.
Write the final Python code implementing the binary search and greedy finishing step.
Run the provided code against Sample 1 and Sample 2 to verify correctness.
